mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.type, a.publisher_id, (SELECT u.real_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = a.publisher_id AND u.deleted = 0) AS publisher_name, a.status, a.view_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.type, a.publisher_id, (SELECT u.real_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = a.publisher_id AND u.deleted = 0) AS publisher_name, a.status, a.view_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time FROM announcement a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = 1), 0) AS published, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = 0), 0) AS draft, COALESCE(SUM(a.view_count), 0) AS view_total FROM announcement a WHERE a.deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM announcement a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
